name: architrave
description: Task-driven domain-aware development and read-only application audits, with canonical lifecycle state, bounded host-native collaboration and independent review. No mandatory modeling ceremony.

interface.longDescription: Track owner requests and scoped corrections through canonical lifecycle state; preserve domain rules through the existing Service Architect, connected implementation and read-only audit. Use bounded collaboration and independent review without mandatory modeling ceremony. Legacy Run and requirements tools remain optional.
